name: Source Collaboration Reassigned
description: Notifies the assignee when a source that has been assigned to them for configuration is reassigned to another user.
subject: $referenceName configuration reassigned to another user
body:
Source configuration reassigned

Dear $__recipient.name,

Your administrator has reassigned the $referenceName onboarding to another user. You no longer have access to this source.

If you have any questions, contact $owner.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
